ndfbd9792a2.headline: TC Energy, Énergir to divest PNGTS for $1.14bn
ndfbd9792a2.summary: TC Energy, in partnership with Énergir, has agreed to sell the Portland Natural Gas Transmission System (PNGTS) for $1.14bn.
ndfbd9792a2.why: TC Energy is a Calgary-based pipeline operator, and pipeline divestments are a common way for midstream companies to reshape their asset portfolios.

n44d41b2b04.headline: Finance ministry official: Armenia government debt increased from 20% to 46% in national currency
n44d41b2b04.summary: A finance ministry official said Armenia's government debt in national currency rose from 20% to 46% over the last four years. The official heads the public debt management department.
n44d41b2b04.why: The mix of local-currency and foreign-currency government debt affects a country's exposure to exchange-rate swings.

ned52e3190f.headline: Deputy economy minister: Emphasis in Armenia should be gradually shifted from classical forms of funding
ned52e3190f.summary: Armenia's deputy economy minister said the state should gradually shift emphasis from classical forms of funding and develop support measures for the capital market.
ned52e3190f.why: Capital market development determines how companies in Armenia raise financing beyond bank lending.

n8c42de7f9d.headline: OPEC to cut 2.2 million barrels per day for another three months
n8c42de7f9d.summary: OPEC+ members, led by Saudi Arabia and Russia, extended production cuts of 2.2 million barrels per day for another three months. The move aims to stabilise the oil market.
n8c42de7f9d.why: OPEC+ is a group of oil producers whose output decisions shape global crude supply and prices. Changes to its quotas directly affect oil-linked equities, currencies and inflation expectations.
n8c42de7f9d.why_moved: OPEC+ extended production cuts of 2.2 million barrels per day for three months, which the producers said aims to stabilise the oil market.

n955215f3e1.headline: Azerbaijan, Qatar discuss cooperation in financial sector [PHOTOS]
n955215f3e1.summary: The Central Bank of Azerbaijan and the Qatar Financial Centre held discussions on cooperation in the financial sector. CBA President Taleh Kazimov shared the meeting on his X account.
n955215f3e1.why: Central bank and financial-centre cooperation can facilitate cross-border investment and financial services between the two countries. Such agreements shape capital flows in the region.

n25754d2712.headline: Argentina Govt Suspends State News Agency Telam
n25754d2712.summary: Argentina's government has suspended state news agency Telam, which has more than 700 staff. The move is the latest in President Milei's drive to shake up or shut state institutions.
n25754d2712.why: Milei's government has pursued spending cuts and state reductions to address Argentina's fiscal deficit, which shapes investor views on the country's economic policy.

ndbe455f8d1.headline: New phase for Saudising aviation jobs gets underway
ndbe455f8d1.summary: A new phase of the plan to Saudise aviation jobs has begun. The plan targets private sector firms employing five or more people.
ndbe455f8d1.why: Saudisation quotas change workforce composition and hiring costs for private employers, including airlines and aviation services in the kingdom.

n9f5577b673.headline: EU Commission proposes 1.5 bln euro common defence industry package
n9f5577b673.summary: The European Commission proposed a new 1.5 billion euro defence industry programme, to be financed from the EU budget for 2025 onward. The proposal aims to support joint defence production.
n9f5577b673.why: EU defence spending decisions direct funding to arms manufacturers and shape the European defence industrial base for investors in the sector.

n3a1f191812.headline: Gauteng reiterates exit of GFIP tolling by end March
n3a1f191812.summary: The Gauteng provincial government has approached financial institutions to raise funds needed to meet contractual obligations ahead of its March 31, 2024 target to scrap GFIP tolling.
n3a1f191812.why: The Gauteng Freeway Improvement Project is a major road-financing contract, and its funding affects lenders and contractors tied to South Africa's largest province.

n4367c5d350.headline: Poland Urges EU Sanctions on Russian, Belarusian Farm Products
n4367c5d350.summary: Poland's prime minister has urged EU sanctions on farm products from Russia and Belarus. He argued their production standards are lower and that pesticides and fertilizers are cheap there.
n4367c5d350.why: Agricultural trade restrictions shift grain and food supply flows and affect prices and competition for EU farmers.

nd1cb63993d.headline: Resolutions of the 2024 annual general meeting of Ørsted A/S
nd1cb63993d.summary: Ørsted A/S held its 2024 annual general meeting on 5 March 2024 and published the decisions taken at the meeting.
nd1cb63993d.why: Ørsted is a Danish offshore wind developer and one of the largest renewable energy producers in Europe, so its governance decisions matter to energy investors.

impacts.name: Ørsted A/S
impacts.why: The annual general meeting decisions directly concern the company's own governance.

nc336d34c50.headline: Talos Energy concludes $1.3bn acquisition of QuarterNorth
nc336d34c50.summary: US oil and gas company Talos Energy has completed its $1.29bn acquisition of QuarterNorth Energy. The deal was completed as announced.
nc336d34c50.why: Talos Energy is a Houston-based offshore oil and gas producer, so acquisitions change its reserves, production and debt profile. Deals like this are closely watched by energy investors.

n455e5acc35.headline: Former Twitter executives sue Elon Musk over firings ‘without cause’
n455e5acc35.summary: A group of former Twitter executives has sued Elon Musk over their dismissals. They are seeking a total of more than 128 million dollars in unpaid severance payments.
n455e5acc35.why: The dispute concerns severance liabilities tied to the 2022 takeover of Twitter, now operated as X, which is privately held by Musk.

nfbdbf49ba8.headline: Philippines companies form alliance to launch $3.3bn LNG facility
nfbdbf49ba8.summary: Three Philippine energy companies have joined forces to launch the country's first integrated LNG facility in Batangas. The project is valued at $3.3 billion.
nfbdbf49ba8.why: LNG imports and terminals are a key source of gas supply for power generation in the Philippines, linking energy security to investment.

n8b0bca4ab3.headline: GSK rewards CEO Emma Walmsley with 51% pay hike after beating sales, profit goals
n8b0bca4ab3.summary: GSK rewarded CEO Emma Walmsley with a 51% pay increase after the company beat its sales and profit goals. She received £12.7 million in total pay last year.
n8b0bca4ab3.why: GSK is a British pharmaceutical company, and executive pay reflects board decisions tied to performance targets.

ndc89a16f89.headline: 'Prepared to win a war': China boosts defence spending, hardens stance on Taiwan
ndc89a16f89.summary: China will boost defence spending by 7.2% this year, according to official reports. The budget has more than doubled under Xi Jinping's decade-plus in office.
ndc89a16f89.why: Defence budgets shape military procurement and regional security risk, which matter for investors exposed to Asia-Pacific trade and defence supply chains.

n14ad319b46.headline: Why Novo Nordisk Stock Tumbled by Nearly 3% on Tuesday
n14ad319b46.summary: Novo Nordisk shares fell nearly 3% on Tuesday. The company continues to study how its most popular molecule can be used for different conditions.
n14ad319b46.why: Novo Nordisk is a Danish drugmaker known for diabetes and obesity treatments built on its GLP-1 drug franchise.

impacts.name: Novo Nordisk
impacts.why: The share price fell nearly 3% on the day reported.

nd2b358727c.headline: Ghana to lose $3.8b World Bank funding if anti-LGBTQ+ bill is signed into law  |
nd2b358727c.summary: Ghana could lose $3.8 billion in World Bank funding if the anti-LGBTQ bill is enacted, according to a BBC report. Financial authorities reportedly suggested postponing signing until the Supreme Court rules on its constitutionality.
nd2b358727c.why: The World Bank provides large development financing to Ghana, so any suspension affects public investment and the government's budget financing.

n95df24cf22.headline: Toronto home sales up in February from last year as consumers eye rate cuts: TRREB  | Globalnews.ca
n95df24cf22.summary: Greater Toronto home sales and listings were up in February from a year earlier, but adjusted sales fell from a month earlier, the Toronto Regional Real Estate Board said.
n95df24cf22.why: The Toronto housing market is a major indicator of Canadian real estate activity, which affects mortgage lending and consumer spending.

n047201ed7d.headline: Inflation rises back above 3 pct in Feb. on high fruit, energy prices
n047201ed7d.summary: South Korea's inflation ticked back up above 3% in February, driven by higher fruit and energy prices, according to Yonhap News Agency. The reading reflects pressure from food and fuel costs.
n047201ed7d.why: Consumer price inflation shapes the Bank of Korea's interest rate decisions and therefore borrowing costs and the won's outlook.

nf95f7a3a27.headline: Bezos Dethrones Musk To Reclaim Title Of World's Richest Man
nf95f7a3a27.summary: Amazon founder Jeff Bezos reclaimed the position of world's richest man on Monday, overtaking Elon Musk on the Bloomberg Billionaires Index. The ranking reflects changes in the fortunes of their holdings.
nf95f7a3a27.why: Bezos founded Amazon and Musk leads Tesla and SpaceX, so changes in their rankings reflect valuation moves in major listed companies.

n7a288ee707.headline: EU-Mercosur: Will the trade negotiation saga ever end?
n7a288ee707.summary: The EU and Mercosur have been negotiating for years on liberalising trade. Brussels is pushing for stronger assurances on climate change and deforestation, and a deal seems elusive.
n7a288ee707.why: The EU-Mercosur agreement would link the European Union with South America's largest trading bloc, affecting tariffs and trade flows in agriculture and industry.

n6a7b7cbff0.headline: Exclusive-Starbucks Middle East franchisee AlShaya to cut over 2,000 jobs, sources say
n6a7b7cbff0.summary: Gulf retailer AlShaya Group, which holds the Starbucks Middle East franchise, plans to lay off over 2,000 people, about 4% of its staff, sources said. The cuts began on Sunday amid consumer boycotts linked to the Gaza war.
n6a7b7cbff0.why: AlShaya is a major Gulf retail and restaurant operator that runs Starbucks, Starbucks' franchise partner in the Middle East, so its results reflect regional consumer demand.

n34273291c3.headline: Oddity Tech:  Q4 Earnings Snapshot
n34273291c3.summary: Tel Aviv-based Oddity Tech reported fourth-quarter earnings of $5.1 million. The company also reported per-share net income in its earnings snapshot.
n34273291c3.why: Oddity Tech is an Israeli-based consumer beauty technology company listed in the US, and its results show performance of its online beauty brands.

n61416b248d.headline: Starbucks Middle East franchisee AlShaya to cut over 2,000 jobs, sources say
n61416b248d.summary: Gulf retail group AlShaya, which holds the rights to operate Starbucks in the Middle East, plans to lay off over 2,000 people as consumer boycotts hit the business, sources say.
n61416b248d.why: AlShaya is a major Gulf franchisee of global consumer brands, so its restructuring and boycott exposure indicate pressure on regional retail and food-service sales.

n9c072e04e8.headline: Stock market update: Nifty IT index  falls  1.59%
n9c072e04e8.summary: The Nifty IT index closed down 1.59 per cent at 36,720.75. The move reflects weakness in India's information technology stocks.
n9c072e04e8.why: The Nifty IT index tracks major Indian software and IT services firms, whose performance is closely watched for signals about global tech-services demand.

nb232667e05.headline: Ghana's Central Bank suspends FX licenses of GT Bank and First Bank
nb232667e05.summary: Ghana's Central Bank has suspended the foreign exchange licences of Guaranty Trust Bank and FBN Bank for one month, effective March 18.
nb232667e05.why: Foreign exchange licences allow banks to deal in currencies, so suspensions affect their FX revenues and client services in Ghana.

n5a1cc0b73f.headline: Canalys: Mediatek ends 2023 as the most dominant chipset provider
n5a1cc0b73f.summary: MediaTek saw a 21% increase in shipments during the holiday season, according to a Canalys report on the Q4 2023 smartphone market. The report is cited as ending 2023 as the most dominant chipset provider.
n5a1cc0b73f.why: MediaTek is a Taiwan-based chip designer whose processors go into many smartphones, so its shipment trends reflect demand across the mobile supply chain.

impacts.name: MediaTek
impacts.why: Its 21% shipment rise in the holiday season indicates stronger chipset demand.

ncbe66214ea.headline: New Pakistan PM Shehbaz Sharif orders 'immediate' talks with IMF for extended facility for ailing economy - Times of India
ncbe66214ea.summary: Pakistan's new Prime Minister Shehbaz Sharif ordered immediate talks with the IMF on an extended fund facility for the cash-strapped economy.
ncbe66214ea.why: The IMF provides balance-of-payments support to Pakistan, and the terms of its programmes shape the country's currency, debt and fiscal policy.
